req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should accept task creation requests without a description field. This implies that the description field is optional. The test suite will verify this behavior by including a positive test case where the description is omitted, a negative test case where a required field is missing, and a boundary test case with a minimal valid payload.

tests.name: test_create_task_without_description
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload omitting the description field.
expected: The response payload contains the task with the correct title and completed status.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "New Task"
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
assert "description" not in response.json()

tests.name: test_create_task_missing_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload missing the title field.
expected: The response contains a validation error indicating the missing title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"description": "Task without title", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]
assert response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"] == "field required"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_minimal_payload
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a minimal valid payload.
expected: The response payload contains the task with the correct title and default completed status.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "A"}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "A"
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
assert "description" not in response.json()
